title: Seabirds after avian flu
headline: After the 2021-22 HPAI outbreak, Great Skua territories at nine Scottish SPAs fell by 77% and Gannet nests at six SPAs by 22%.

title: Harbour and grey seals
headline: 19,978 harbour seals counted in 2021-25: the lowest since the first census and 26% below 2016-19. Counts fell in all seven units.

title: Wild Atlantic salmon
headline: 115 of 173 assessed stocks (66%) are in poor conservation status for 2026, up from 102 in 2021.

title: Sea temperature
headline: No clear trend at Stonehaven or Loch Ewe over about 20 years, against a background of longer-term warming in Scottish waters.

title: MPA coverage and 30x30
headline: 36.9% of Scottish seas is designated, above the 30% area threshold. Whether sites are effectively managed is the open question.
